summary: Full frontend test of Gold Skin Spa & Beauty single-page site. All 8 requested feature areas verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Hero renders with 'Gold Skin' / 'Spa & Beauty' headline, all 9 required sections mount with expected data-testids (navbar, hero, about, services[8], gallery[3], gift cards[3], faq[5], lead capture, contact, footer). Navigation smooth-scroll works (services scrollY=2294, Book Now scrollY=7291). FAQ toggles expand. Gift card, lead capture (empty + valid), and contact form (empty + valid + service select change) all show correct sonner toasts with expected copy; forms reset after successful submit. Gallery compare sliders present with drag handle. No console errors observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only build; forms are demo (sonner toasts). data-testids used: hero-section, navbar, nav-link-*, nav-book-now, about/services/gallery/giftcards/faq/lead-capture/contact-section, footer, service-item-01..08, gallery-item-0..2, gift-card-buy-0..2, faq-toggle-0..4, lead-capture-email/submit, contact-name/email/service/submit. Toast copy verified: 'The Glow gift card ($100) added — checkout is coming soon.', 'Please enter your email.', "You're on the list — welcome to Gold Skin.", 'Please add your name and email.', 'Request received — our concierge will be in touch shortly.'. Lenis smooth scroll present — allow ~2s between scroll actions.
